digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate run summary and LLM observability
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures (e.g., overlap-judge batches) are invisible to a caller consuming the gate's JSON verdict because they are swallowed with no counter in coverage
Failed LLM calls all funnel through a single seam (runner.py:573 except block) but write only to JSONL spend logs, never to the in-memory verdict object
An empty overlap array caused by three dead judge batches is byte-identical to one caused by no actual overlaps, making the failure mode undetectable
A new run-scoped contextvar-based sink in step_failures.py records failures at the runner seam and drains them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation safety
The failure counter is keyed by _call_label verbatim and shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<label>: <int>}}, matching the log lines operators grep for
Text rendering of plan-review verdicts prints the total and per-step failure counts when present and omits them entirely for clean runs
